name: cursor-skill-bridge
description: Copies selected Cursor skills and plugins from the host into a Dev Container.

scripts.package: npm run test && npm run compile && vsce package

commands.title: Sync Cursor Item in User Settings

viewsWelcome.contents:
No skills or plugins were found on the host.
[Choose discovered items](command:cursorSkillBridge.pickItems)
[Add a folder](command:cursorSkillBridge.addFolder)

cursorSkillBridge.autoSync.markdownDescription:
[Show local skills and plugins](command:cursorSkillBridge.pickItems) and choose what to copy into the Dev Container.

Sync the selected items when a Dev Container opens.

cursorSkillBridge.watch.description: Watch the selected host folders and sync changes. If there are more than 5000 files, or watching is unavailable, sync runs only on connect and on command.

path.description: Host folder. Absolute, ~/... for your home directory, or relative to a locally opened workspace. Inside a Dev Container a relative path is resolved from your home directory.

target.description: Container path for this folder. Required for a folder outside ~/.cursor/skills and ~/.cursor/plugins/local. If omitted, those two locations keep the same path in the container.

enabled.description: Clear this to keep the path and skip sync.

cursorSkillBridge.folders.markdownDescription:
[Choose discovered skills and plugins](command:cursorSkillBridge.pickItems). The same list applies to every workspace from User Settings, and only to this workspace from `.vscode/settings.json`. A workspace entry for the same path overrides the user entry.

`path` may be absolute, `~/...` for the host home, or relative to a locally opened workspace. Inside a Dev Container a relative path is resolved from the host home. `{ "path": "/absolute/path", "enabled": false }` keeps the path and turns sync off. `target` is only needed for an arbitrary folder. `~` in `target` is the container user's HOME.
